captured_by_phase: K5 vendor mech codepoint migration (compliance-audit B-1)

authority.note: Authority file lives in the private repo; CI gate verifies sha256 match. Update this manifest's `authority.sha256` whenever the authority file changes.

active._note: First genuinely vendor-compliant entries since K5 (2026-06-10) — allocated 2026-07-06 per authority file §1.4, at or above CKM_VENDOR_DEFINED/CKK_VENDOR_DEFINED (0x80000000). Backed by pure-Rust crates (frodo-kem, classic-mceliece-rust) in softhsmrustv3, per cacp-frodokem-mceliece-softhsm-kmip-policy-plan-07062026.md. HQC intentionally not allocated yet — deferred pending hqc-kem crate maturity and BSI recommending it with parameters (neither true as of TR-02102-1 v2026-01).

0x80000003.algorithm: Classic McEliece (parameter set per Phase-0.5 scoping decision)

standard_pkcs11_v3_2._note: Informational — the standard OASIS PKCS#11 v3.2 PQC codepoints the KMIP layer now emits (source of truth: src/lib/pkcs11/pkcs11t.h, mirrored by softhsmrustv3::constants). These are NOT vendor mechs and are NOT governed by the authority file's allocation table.

retired._note: Retired 2026-06-10 (K5). Codepoints stay reserved forever per the authority file's mutation policy and must never be re-used as vendor IDs — their numeric values mean what pkcs11t.h says (CKM_HSS/CKM_XMSS*).

0x4032.replaced_by: 0x2D CKM_SLH_DSA_KEY_PAIR_GEN (was mislabeled: KMIP used it for SLH-DSA keygen)

provisional_v0_5_x._note: 0x4040–0x404F codepoints reserved by P0-ALGO-SURFACE. NOT shipping. K5 caveat: this range also violates the CKM_VENDOR_DEFINED (0x80000000) rule — these MUST be re-allocated at 0x80000000 | n in the authority file before any of them ship. Kept here only as a historical reservation record.

vendor_tags._note: PQCToday KMIP TTLV vendor-extension tags. KMIP 3.0 §11.57 (Tag Enumeration) reserves Item Tags 0x540000–0x54FFFF for Extensions (standard tags use first byte 0x42). Allocations are append-only. Source of truth: kmip/src/kmip30/vendor_tags.rs.

0x540001.name: PQCToday-SharedSecret
0x540001.semantics: The ML-KEM encapsulation shared secret. KMIP 3.0 has no Encapsulate operation — this server overloads Encrypt/Decrypt for ML-KEM encap/decap as a documented vendor extension. Replaces the pre-K10 stopgap that emitted the secret under the standard IVCounterNonce tag (0x42003d), which was wire-ambiguous with classical RandomIV responses (compliance-audit B-7). IVCounterNonce is now strictly an IV.

consumer_contract.ci_gate: Any CI job that touches this manifest MUST recompute the authority sha256 and fail if it diverges from `authority.sha256` above. Mech codepoints are append-only — retired codepoints stay reserved forever per the authority file's mutation policy.
downstream_consumers: pqctoday-sandbox tests/* (every PQC test script that hardcodes mech IDs)
